qa_pairs.question: On the CPU job page in the Metrix portal, what local disk activity metrics are graphically presented under the "Full node resources" section, and what do they show?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "Full node resources" section of a CPU job page in the Metrix portal, two graphs display local disk activity: the left graph illustrates the evolution of Input/Output Operations Per Second (IOPS) over time, while the right graph shows the evolution of local disk bandwidth, indicating the quantity of data read or written per second over time.

qa_pairs.question: What is an important consideration when interpreting the "Full node resources" statistics, such as local disk IOPS and bandwidth, for a CPU job in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: When interpreting "Full node resources" statistics, including local disk IOPS and bandwidth, for a CPU job in the Metrix portal, it is important to note that these statistics can be imprecise if the node is shared among multiple users.
